title: The Adorkable Misogyny of The Big Bang Theory
summary: A video essay from Pop Culture Detective arguing that The Big Bang Theory normalizes sexism and toxic masculinity through its portrayal of nerd men. It analyzes recurring tropes in how the male leads treat women.
why: Cited as a critique whenever HN discusses the show's depiction of nerd culture and STEM men.
